title: Faint exoplanets detected using computational approach to remove glare from stars
description:
Nature, Published online: 04 November 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03295-6

An image-processing framework for detecting exoplanets directly has been developed. The technique overcomes the telescope-stability barrier that has limited previous methods, reveals fainter exoplanets than other approaches can detect and could make imaging exo-Earths easier for future observatories.
